pages.text: $(l)Redstone sets the throttle$()$(br)Give any block of the engine a redstone signal. The strongest signal on the row counts: signal 15 is full power, signal 0 stops it. The output speed is $(item)100 RPM x type speed x fuel speed x upgrades x signal / 15$(), capped at 256 RPM.
$(l)Fuel$()$(br)Pipe fuel into any block of the engine. It must be one of the fuels the cylinders accept. When the tank runs dry the engine stops.

$(l)Exhaust$()$(br)A running engine fills its $(item)exhaust tank (8000 mB) with CO2$(). When it is full the engine stops. Pump the CO2 out of the engine with a pipe into an $(item)Exhaust$() block, which vents it as smoke, or into a tank.
The engine stops as well while a component or a cylinder is missing, so check the goggles first when nothing turns.
